newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices firm after auction starts late.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices firm after auction starts late.

text.p: Coffee prices were on average higher compared to last week after bidders were delayed by an air traffic control go-slow at Kenyan airports and the auction began late, dealers said.
Some bidders usually fly to Nairobi from the coastal city of Mombasa for the auctions.
"Prices were steady, with the miscellaneous slightly high," said a dealer, adding that prices were still good relative to quality for the drought-hit coffees.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 20,323 of the 20,419 60-kg bags on offer, compared with its sale of all 20,526 bags auctioned last week.
